text:
Priya Nair: Quick QBR heads-up for NovaPay: token burn ~3x M/M, onboarding still in 'integration' stage, finance flagged renewals risk. Can we assemble cost optimization + enablement plan by EOD Friday? Budget alert tripped. TL;DR below.

BillingBot: ALERT: NovaPay (acct: NP-443) usage 87% of committed quota this billing cycle. See dashboard: https://console.redwood.example/billing/NP-443 :warning:

Jordan Lee: @Priya I pulled spend forecast — if usage trend continues, projected monthly cost = $48.5k (vs committed $18k). That's with current avg tokens/session=1.2k. Attaching quick calc:`forecast = current_spend * (1 + growth_rate)^(remaining_days/30)`

Kelsea Park: Onboarding update: integration stalled on webhook retries. CS ELT working with infra to whitelist IPs. We're running enablement workshop Wednesday 2pm PT — propose we add a 'cost controls' module.

Evan R.: @Jordan +1. Short-term mitigations: reduce max_tokens default to 512 for web flows, enable prefix caching for FAQ routes, and set soft rate limits per user. We can push a config via Dedicated policies: sample patch:`routes.default.max_tokens=512`

Priya Nair: Love the mitigations. Can someone draft the QBR slide with: one-slide spend graph, list of mitigations + expected % reduction, renewal risk rating (Low/Med/High), and ask for committed usage increase or pricing review?

Jordan Lee: I'll draft. Estimated reduction: caching + token cap ~= 35-45% token burn drop in web flows. Quantization suggestion for embeddings could cut embedding cost 60% but needs model validation.

Kelsea Park: Flagging renewal risk as 'Medium - elevated spend' until mitigations implemented + enablement progress. I'll loop CRO & Solutions Eng on the ask. Also capture customer feedback: they want clearer cost controls in Console.

Priya Nair: Great. Action items: Jordan slide deck, Evan implement token caps + caching by Tue EOD, Kelsea run enablement + collect feedback, I'll own QBR send invite. :white_check_mark:
